notes.title: Planet of the Apes: Last Frontier - June 2nd Update
Planet of the Apes: Last Frontier launches August 24th
notes.content:
Planet of the Apes: Last Frontier will finally launch for PC on the 24th of August. Some of its features include:

- 19 ways of completing the game.
- Overall amount of 14 hours of available game content
- Player plays as both apes and humans
- Includes 4 player local multiplayer
- Additional improvements on player feedback and ability to replay from chapter starts
- Active Mixer voting support.
- Achievements.
